newsitem.title: GERMANY: BHF says will make Singapore its Asia HQ.
newsitem.headline: BHF says will make Singapore its Asia HQ.

text.p: Germany's BHF-Bank AG said on Monday it would turn its Singapore office into the headquarters for its Asia business in a reorganisation of its activities in the region.
The bank said in a statement it would move its trading business from Tokyo to Singapore which would become its centre for currency dealing in the Asian time zones.
BHF said it would turn its Tokyo branch into a representative office as part of the revamp.
Singapore and Hong Kong will serve as bases for BHF's business with corporate customers in the region, BHF said.

Equinox Group Holding Ltd, the newly formed merchant bank of which BHF and its French partner Credit Commercial de France together own 30 percent, will play an important role in BHF's activities in Asia, BHF said.
Equinox, set up in the summer, aims to support multinational French and German companies in their expansion in Asia, BHF said.
BHF said the reorganisation highlighted its position as "knowhow centre for selective, worldwide bank services in consultancy and trading."
It said it would continue to expand that position by including local partners.
